# Documentero

Documentero generates Word, PDF, and Excel documents from reusable templates and structured data.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/documentero/.

## Actions

- **Generate Document**: Generate a DOCX, PDF, or XLSX document from a Documentero template and data.
- **Get Template JSON Schema** (read-only): Return the JSON Schema for the data object accepted when generating a document from a template.
- **Get Template Metadata** (read-only): Return a template's Documentero field definitions, nested field options, supported output formats, and default output format.
- **List Templates** (read-only): Return all templates available to the connected Documentero account, including each template identifier and type-bearing label.
